question: At a fixed 89-feature capacity, does adding exact checked synthetic training worlds improve sequential utility on an untouched block?

model_family.representation: 34 base features plus 55 quadratic interactions among 10 PCA coordinates
model_family.labels: exact finite-horizon dynamic-programming Q advantages from the authored synthetic world model
model_family.hyperparameters: unchanged from the published 32-world PCA-quadratic candidate

controls: the same rank-10 PCA-quadratic architecture trained on 32 worlds

evaluation_block.prior_use: none known; block is frozen for this one evaluation

knowledge_scaling_gate.paired_utility: wins must exceed losses and the two-sided exact sign-test p-value must be below 0.05
knowledge_scaling_gate.capacity: both models must have exactly 89 features

representation_gate.comparison: 128-world PCA-quadratic model versus equal-data 128-world plain linear model
representation_gate.mean_optimal_utility_ratio: PCA-quadratic model must be strictly greater
representation_gate.minimum_optimal_utility_ratio: PCA-quadratic model must be no lower
representation_gate.mean_gain_over_myopic: PCA-quadratic model must be strictly greater

curve_diagnostics_not_used_for_selection: paired mean, median, minimum, and maximum utility deltas
falsifier: The knowledge-scaling claim is refuted if any knowledge-scaling gate fails. The representation claim is judged independently. A completed negative result is evidence, not a runner failure.
anti_tuning_rule: No training budget, feature, rank, regularizer, seed range, control, metric, or threshold may change after evaluation begins. A procedural repair must be recorded as an amendment and cannot restore freshness to an observed block.
nonclaims: The exact labels come from an authored model rather than an external environment.
More generated rows are not called knowledge unless fixed-capacity held-out utility improves under the declared gate.
A positive result would establish scaling only from 32 to 128 worlds inside this bounded generator.
This does not establish real-world welfare, morality, unrestricted generalization, or general intelligence.
The floating-point model is not the deployed Tau-gated Qgent.
